headline: 兩位藝文界人物辭世
context: 歌手艾琳．史密斯（Arlene Smith）辭世。她是1950年代女子團體先驅『香特爾斯』合唱團（The Chantels）的主唱，1957年在紐約唱片公司一鳴驚人，隔年主唱單曲《Maybe》銷量突破百萬張，也為後來一批女子團體立下典範。同一天，體育攝影師克里斯．史密斯（Chris Smith）也辭世，他一生記錄了無數傳奇運動員的身影。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Singer with one of the first ‘girl groups’, the Chantels, whose 1950s hit Maybe sold more than a million copies Almost before the five Bronx schoolgirls who called themselves the Chantels had finished their unaccompanied delivery of a song called The Plea in his office on Broadway one day in 1957, the record label owner George Goldner was fishing in his desk for a contract they could take home and show their parents. Within months the group were high in the charts with a ballad called Maybe , featuring the powerful lead voice of the 16-year-old Arlene Smith. The Chantels set the pattern for the success of such “girl groups”, as they became known, as the Shirelles , the Crystals , the Chiffons, the Ronettes , and many more. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Sports photographer for the Observer and the Sunday Times who sought to capture human drama and emotion When the Beatles waltzed unannounced into the 5th Street Gym in Miami Beach in 1964, the sports photographer Chris Smith seized the moment. He was there to record Cassius Clay (later Muhammad Ali ) in training for his fight with Sonny Liston, but when the Fab Four began hamming it up with the Greatest, he captured the five most famous faces on the planet in one memorable shot. Ali went on to furnish Smith with many unforgettable images over the years, and the photographer seemed always to be in the right place at the right time to document the host of larger-than-life sporting characters who peopled the last four decades of the 20th century, including George Best , Seve Ballesteros , Frank Bruno, Martina Navratilova and Lester Piggott . 體育攝影師克里斯．史密斯過世，1964年曾捕捉披頭四意外闖入拳王阿里訓練場的經典合影。

thread_text:
歌手艾琳．史密斯（Arlene Smith）辭世。她是1950年代女子團體先驅『香特爾斯』合唱團（The Chantels）的主唱，1957年五名布朗克斯的女學生，在紐約唱片公司經紀人喬治．高德納（George Goldner）面前清唱一曲，當場獲得合約。隔年，由16歲的史密斯主唱的單曲《Maybe》銷量突破百萬張，也為後來謝萊爾斯（Shirelles）等一批女子團體立下典範。同一天，體育攝影師克里斯．史密斯（Chris Smith）也辭世。他曾在1964年，披頭四（The Beatles）意外闖入拳王阿里（Muhammad Ali）的邁阿密訓練場，被他捕捉下五張當代最知名面孔同框的經典畫面，一生記錄了無數傳奇運動員的身影。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 歌手艾琳．史密斯過世了。她是1950年代女子團體先驅『香特爾斯』合唱團的主唱。1957年，五名布朗克斯的女學生，在紐約一位唱片公司經紀人面前清唱一曲，當場就拿到了合約。隔年，由16歲的史密斯主唱的單曲《Maybe》，銷量突破百萬張，也為後來一整批女子團體，立下了典範。同一天，體育攝影師克里斯．史密斯，也過世了。他曾在1964年，披頭四意外闖入拳王阿里的邁阿密訓練場，捕捉下五張當代最知名面孔同框的經典畫面。他一生，記錄了無數傳奇運動員的身影。
